****Turkey: taxes, buying, residence permit****

- **Right of Russian citizens to buy**: General principle (Russia is not named in the source): the countries whose nationals are eligible to acquire real estate in Türkiye are determined by the Cabinet of Ministers, which may also set special conditions. Whether Russia is on the list — see the field “Is Russia on the country list” below. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [invest.gov.tr](https://www.invest.gov.tr/en/investmentguide/pages/acquiring-property-and-citizenship.aspx); Quote: «Countries whose nationals are eligible to acquire real estate in Türkiye are determined by the Cabinet of Ministers, who may also stipulate special conditions for acquisitions if deemed necessary.»)
- **Right of UK citizens to buy**: FCDO guidance for British nationals states the general conditions for foreigners: up to 30 hectares in Turkey in total per person plus limited rights in rem; no acquisition or rental within military forbidden zones and security zones. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/how-to-buy-property-in-turkey); Quote: «a) Persons with foreign nationality can buy maximum 30 hectares of property in Turkey in total and can acquire limited in rem right. b) Foreigners cannot acquire or rent property within military forbidden zones and security zones.»)
- **Title deed fee (tapu harcı)**: Title deed fee (tapu harcı) on transfer: 20 per mille (2%) of the declared actual transfer price, charged separately to buyer and seller. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [cdn.gib.gov.tr](https://cdn.gib.gov.tr/api/gibportal-file/file/getFileResources?objectKey=arsiv%2Fonceki-dokumanlar%2Fgayrimenkul_alimsatim_vergilendirilmesi.pdf); Quote: «Gayrimenkul devir ve iktisaplarında tapu harcı, beyan edilen gerçek devir ve iktisap bedeli üzerinden binde 20 oranında alıcı ve satıcıdan ayrı ayrı alınır.»)
- **Annual property tax**: Property tax (emlak vergisi) rates: residential buildings 1 per mille (0.1%), other buildings 2 per mille, land 1, building plots 3 per mille. Within metropolitan municipality boundaries and adjacent areas the rates are increased by 100%. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [cdn.gib.gov.tr](https://cdn.gib.gov.tr/api/gibportal-file/file/getFileResources?objectKey=arsiv/onceki-dokumanlar/emlak_ver_rehber_2025.pdf); Quote: «Bina vergisinin oranı meskenlerde binde 1, • Diğer binalarda binde 2, • Arazide binde 1 ve arsalarda binde 3’tür. Bina, arsa ve arazilere ilişkin vergi oranları büyükşehir belediye sınırları ve mücavir alanlar içinde %100 artırımlı uygulanır.»)
- **Rental income tax (non-resident)**: Rental income is taxed at a progressive scale (GİB guide for non-residents): 15%, 20%, 27%, 35%, 40% with TL brackets. The regime for short-term rentals and rental pools is not covered by this quote (see the short-term rental field below). (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [cdn.gib.gov.tr](https://cdn.gib.gov.tr/api/gibportal-file/file/getFileResources?objectKey=arsiv%2Ffileadmin%2Fbeyannamerehberi%2F2026%2F2026_theguidebooktaxpayers.pdf); Quote: «Income subject to income tax is taxed at the following rates. Up to the amount of 158.000 TL 15% 23.700 TL for 158.000 TL of 330.000 TL, over 20% 58.100 TL for 330.000 TL of 800.000 TL (for wage incomes 58.100 TL for 330.000 TL of 1.200.000 TL), over 27% 185.000 TL for 800.000 TL of 4.300.000 TL, (for wage incomes 293.000 TL for 1.200.000 TL of 4.300.000 TL), over 35% 1.410.000 TL for 4.300.000 TL of amount exceeding 4.300.000 TL (for wage incomes 1.378.000 TL for 4.300.000 TL of amount exceeding 4.300.000 TL), over 40%»)
- **Residence permit via property: minimum value**: For applicants owning immovable property in Türkiye: a document showing the residence belongs to the applicant (title deed copy); the house must be worth at least USD 200 thousand (TRY equivalent) as of the date of acquisition. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [e-ikamet.goc.gov.tr](https://e-ikamet.goc.gov.tr/Ikamet/BasvuruIstenenBelgeler/BasvuruFormuIstenenBelgeler?tur=0); Quote: «b. Those owning immovable property in Türkiye  Official, e-signed/signed and sealed/stamped document showing that the residence belongs to the applicant foreigner (Photocopy of the title deed) (The value of the house must be at least 200 thousand US Dollars equivalent to Turkish Lira as of the date of acquisition).»)
- **Residence permit: property use requirement**: The property must be a residence and be used by the foreigner for this purpose; it cannot be used for rent or similar income-generating purposes. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [e-ikamet.goc.gov.tr](https://e-ikamet.goc.gov.tr/Ikamet/BasvuruIstenenBelgeler/BasvuruFormuIstenenBelgeler?tur=0); Quote: «(The immovable property must be a residence and must be used by the foreigner for this purpose. The residence cannot be used for rent and similar income generating purposes.)»)
- **Citizenship-by-investment threshold**: Citizenship criterion: acquiring property worth at least USD 400,000 or equivalent foreign currency with a title-deed restriction on resale for at least three years, as attested by the Ministry of Environment, Urbanization and Climate Change. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [invest.gov.tr](https://www.invest.gov.tr/en/investmentguide/pages/acquiring-property-and-citizenship.aspx); Quote: «Acquiring a property worth a minimum of USD 400,000 or equivalent foreign currency with a title deed restriction on its resale for at least three years, as attested by the Ministry of Environment, Urbanization and Climate Change»)
- **Purchase procedure**: Documents for the land registry procedure (invest.gov.tr, «Requirements for Land Registry Procedures»): ID or passport, representation document (if any), municipal market-value document, mandatory earthquake insurance for buildings. Other steps are listed as separate fields below. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [invest.gov.tr](https://www.invest.gov.tr/en/investmentguide/pages/acquiring-property-and-citizenship.aspx); Quote: «Photo ID or passport issued by the country of which the foreigner is a citizen (notarized and certified translations should be submitted for ID cards and passports issued in alphabets other than the Latin alphabet) If the procedure involves representation, document regarding representation (order regarding guardianship, letter of authorization, power of attorney etc.) Document on the current market value of the real estate issued by the relevant municipality Mandatory earthquake insurance policy for the buildings»)
- **Is Russia on the list of eligible countries**: no data (Checked: 2026-10-19; [invest.gov.tr](https://www.invest.gov.tr/en/investmentguide/pages/acquiring-property-and-citizenship.aspx))
- **Restrictions on foreign buyers**: General limits for foreigners: at most 30 hectares in Turkey in total per person; no acquisition or rental within military forbidden zones and security zones; persons with foreign nationality can acquire property or limited rights in rem in a district/town up to 10% of the total area of that district/town. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/how-to-buy-property-in-turkey); Quote: «a) Persons with foreign nationality can buy maximum 30 hectares of property in Turkey in total and can acquire limited in rem right. b) Foreigners cannot acquire or rent property within military forbidden zones and security zones. c) Persons with foreign nationality can acquire property or limited in rem right in a district/town up to 10 % of the total area of the said district/town.»)
- **Withholding tax on rent**: Tenants that are persons, corporations or entities referred to in the guide must withhold income tax at 20% of the gross rental payments. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [cdn.gib.gov.tr](https://cdn.gib.gov.tr/api/gibportal-file/file/getFileResources?objectKey=arsiv%2Ffileadmin%2Fbeyannamerehberi%2F2026%2F2026_theguidebooktaxpayers.pdf); Quote: «Persons, corporations and entities in question that are tenants have to withhold income tax from the gross amount of their rental payments at the rate of 20%.»)
- **Residential rental income exemption**: Residential rental income is exempt from income tax up to TRY 47,000 for 2025 (TRY 58,000 for 2026); stated in the GİB guide for non-resident taxpayers. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [cdn.gib.gov.tr](https://cdn.gib.gov.tr/api/gibportal-file/file/getFileResources?objectKey=arsiv%2Ffileadmin%2Fbeyannamerehberi%2F2026%2F2026_theguidebooktaxpayers.pdf); Quote: «The amount of 47.000 TL for rental income from house for the year 2025 (the exception amount of 58.000 TL for the year 2026) is exempted from the income tax.»)
- **Short-term letting: taxation**: Turkish Revenue Administration (GİB, a private ruling — özelge — issued to a taxpayer): continuously letting real estate for short periods (daily, weekly or monthly) within a commercial organisation is treated as a commercial activity, and the income is taxed under the Income Tax Law rules on commercial income (ticari kazanç). (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [gib.gov.tr](https://gib.gov.tr/mevzuat/kanun/433/ozelge/38812); Quote: «Buna göre, gayrimenkulleri ticari bir organizasyon çerçevesinde devamlı olarak günlük, haftalık veya aylık periyotlar halinde kısa süreli olarak kiraya verme faaliyetinizin ticari faaliyet kapsamında değerlendirilmesi ve bu faaliyet dolayısıyla elde ettiğiniz kazancın da Gelir Vergisi Kanununun ticari kazanca ilişkin hükümlerine göre vergilendirilmesi gerekmektedir.»)
- **Short-term letting: bookkeeping (FCDO guidance)**: Per FCDO guidance (gov.uk): income from short-period rentals is subject to commercial income tax; a tax account, an accountant and financial books are required. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/how-to-buy-property-in-turkey); Quote: «On the other hand, if you rent for short periods then this income will be subject to commercial income tax. You must have a tax account, an accountant, and keep financial books.»)
- **Purchase step: encumbrance check**: Mortgages, liens and similar restrictions that could prevent the sale are checked before procedures start at the land registry directorate. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [invest.gov.tr](https://www.invest.gov.tr/en/investmentguide/pages/acquiring-property-and-citizenship.aspx); Quote: «Burdens such as mortgages, liens, and similar types of restrictions that may exist with regard to the said property that would prevent the sale thereof should be checked prior to the initiation of procedures at the respective land registry directorate.»)
- **Purchase step: foreigner ID number**: A buyer without a residence permit needs a Foreigner Identity number (Yabancı Kimlik No.) from the TNP Foreigners’ Department in the nearest city; the service is free (per FCDO guidance). (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/how-to-buy-property-in-turkey); Quote: «However, anyone wishing to buy property in Turkey who does not hold a residence permit needs to obtain their Foreigner Identity number (Yabanci Kimlik No.) from the TNP Foreigners’ Department in the nearest city (not local town) in order to proceed with the property purchase. This service is free of charge.»)
- **Purchase step: valuation report**: The evaluation report is valid for three months and is submitted to the title deed office (per FCDO guidance). (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/how-to-buy-property-in-turkey); Quote: «The evaluation report, which is valid only for three months, should be submitted to the title deed office.»)
- **Purchase step: tapu application**: The buyer applies to the land registry together with the owner; appointments via the Alo 181 call centre or randevu.tkgm.gov.tr. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [invest.gov.tr](https://www.invest.gov.tr/en/investmentguide/pages/acquiring-property-and-citizenship.aspx); Quote: «A natural or legal person intending to acquire real estate in Türkiye is required to apply to the General Directorate of Land Registry and Cadastre together with the owner of the property. In addition, they may call the Alo 181 Call Center, offering service around the clock, or visit randevu.tkgm.gov.tr to make an appointment without having to visit the directorates’ offices in person.»)
- **Purchase step: title registration**: Preliminary real estate contracts (notarised or written between individuals) do not transfer ownership per se; they are only a commitment to transfer. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [invest.gov.tr](https://www.invest.gov.tr/en/investmentguide/pages/acquiring-property-and-citizenship.aspx); Quote: «Preliminary real estate contracts, issued by notaries or entered into by natural persons in writing, do not confer transfer of property per se. They only serve as a commitment for the transfer of ownership; the property in question does not change hands by means of such instruments.»)
- **Sales to foreigners statistics**: no data (Checked: 2026-10-19; [veriportali.tuik.gov.tr](https://veriportali.tuik.gov.tr/tr/press/58350/metadata))

## What we don't know

What our sources do not confirm — and ready questions you can ask the seller yourself.

**Not found** (10): Brand, Operator, Ministry of Culture and Tourism licence (KTB), Year-round or seasonal, Rental programme type, Owner's share of income, Guaranteed income, Owner nights per year, Rental contract term, Red flags

**Seller's claim** (8): Address, Project type, Developer / seller, Project status, Stars, Number of rooms, Rental programme, Title type

### Questions for the seller

#### Project

1. Please give the exact address of the project (il / ilçe / mahalle, street) and the land registry plot (ada / parsel).
2. Is this a hotel, apart-hotel or serviced residence according to its documents?
3. Under which hotel brand does (will) the property operate? Is a franchise or management agreement signed — please send a copy or an extract.
4. Who is the hotel operator (legal entity) and who is the counterparty of the owner's rental agreement? What happens if the operator changes?
5. Who is the developer (legal entity) and who is the seller under the sale contract?
6. Is the property operating or under construction? If under construction — the contractual completion date and building permit (yapı ruhsatı); if operating — the opening year and occupancy permit (iskân).
7. What official star rating has the hotel been assigned (per the Ministry of Culture and Tourism certificate)?
8. Does the hotel hold a Ministry of Culture and Tourism licence (Turizm İşletme Belgesi)? Please send its number and a copy.
9. How many rooms are in the hotel part in total and how many of them are sold to private owners?
10. Does the hotel operate year-round or seasonally? In which months is it closed?

#### Rental

1. Is there a rental programme run by the operator? Please send a sample agreement.
2. Is the rental programme a shared pool (income split among all owners) or individual (income from your own unit)?
3. What share of rental income does the owner receive and which costs are deducted before it is calculated?
4. Is there a guaranteed income? Who exactly guarantees it (legal entity), for how long, on what base amount, and how is the guarantee secured?
5. How many nights a year may the owner stay in the unit and are there restrictions by month?
6. For what term is the rental/management agreement signed, how can it be terminated and what happens if the operator changes?

#### Title and documents

1. Is a separate title deed (kat mülkiyeti / kat irtifakı) issued for the unit? Please send a copy showing the plot number.
2. Please give the full legal name (unvan), tax number (vergi no) or MERSIS of the developer and the hotel-owning company; have they had konkordato, liquidation, a change of owners or icra sales involving the property?

## Tax and law

### Citizenship: Russia

- **Entry**: Russian citizens with ordinary passports are visa-exempt for tourist and business trips to Türkiye of up to 60 days. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [mfa.gov.tr](https://www.mfa.gov.tr/visa-information-for-foreigners.en.mfa); Quote: «Russian Federation: Ordinary passport holders are exempted from visa for their touristic and business travels up to 60 days.»)
- **Currency control**: A resident individual files the report with the tax office annually, by 1 June of the year following the reporting year. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [nalog.gov.ru](https://www.nalog.gov.ru/rn77/related_activities/exchange_controls/); Quote: «Физическое лицо - резидент представляет в налоговый орган по месту своего учета отчет ежегодно, до 1 июня года, следующего за отчетным годом.»)
- **Notice to Russian tax service of a foreign account**: A resident must notify the tax office of opening, closing or changing details of an account with a foreign (e.g. Turkish) bank within one month. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [nalog.gov.ru](https://www.nalog.gov.ru/rn77/fl/interest/account_opening/); Quote: «Резидент уведомляет налоговый орган по месту своего учета об открытии (закрытии) счетов (вкладов) и об изменении реквизитов счетов (вкладов) в банках и иных организациях финансового рынка, расположенных за пределами территории Российской Федерации, не позднее одного месяца со дня соответственно открытия (закрытия) или изменения реквизитов таких счетов (вкладов) по форме, утвержденной федеральным органом исполнительной власти, уполномоченным по контролю и надзору в области налогов и сборов.»)
- **Transfer limits**: From 8 December 2025 the Bank of Russia lifted the previously set limits on foreign-currency transfers abroad for Russian citizens and non-resident individuals from friendly countries. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [cbr.ru](https://www.cbr.ru/press/event?id=28158); Quote: «Учитывая стабильную ситуацию на валютном рынке, с 8 декабря 2025 года Банк России отменяет ранее установленные лимиты на переводы иностранной валюты за рубеж для граждан России и физических лиц – нерезидентов из дружественных стран.»)
- **Banks and transfer methods**: no data (Checked: 2026-10-19; Where we searched: cbr.ru nalog.gov.ru mfa.gov.tr tcmb.gov.tr)
- **Currency control: exemption for stays abroad over 183 days (accounts)**: The requirements on opening accounts (deposits) with foreign banks and other financial-market organisations do not apply to residents who stay outside Russia for more than 183 days in total during a calendar year. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [nalog.gov.ru](https://www.nalog.gov.ru/rn77/related_activities/exchange_controls/); Quote: «Требования к порядку открытия счетов (вкладов) в банках и иных организациях финансового рынка, расположенных за пределами территории Российской Федерации, не применяются к физическим лицам - резидентам, срок пребывания которых за пределами территории Российской Федерации в течение календарного года в совокупности составит более 183 дней»)
- **Currency control: exemption for stays abroad over 183 days (reports)**: The requirements to file cash-flow reports on accounts with foreign banks and other financial-market organisations (and reports on transfers via foreign payment providers without an account) do not apply to residents who stay outside Russia for more than 183 days in total during a calendar year. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [nalog.gov.ru](https://www.nalog.gov.ru/rn77/related_activities/exchange_controls/); Quote: «Требования к порядку представления отчетов о движении денежных средств и иных финансовых активов по счетам (вкладам) в банках и иных организациях финансового рынка, расположенных за пределами территории Российской Федерации и отчетов о переводах денежных средств без открытия банковского счета с использованием электронных средств платежа, предоставленных иностранными поставщиками платежных услуг не применяются к физическим лицам - резидентам, срок пребывания которых за пределами территории Российской Федерации в течение календарного года в совокупности составит более 183 дней»)
- **Currency control: credits to a foreign account**: Since 1 January 2020 residents may credit funds from non-residents to their foreign accounts without restriction, provided the account is in an EAEU state or a state that exchanges financial information automatically with Russia. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [nalog.gov.ru](https://www.nalog.gov.ru/rn77/related_activities/exchange_controls/); Quote: «С 1 января 2020 года физические лица – резиденты могут без ограничений зачислять средства от нерезидентов на свои зарубежные счета при условии: счет должен быть открыт в зарубежном банке на территории государства-члена ЕАЭС (Беларуси, Казахстана, Армении, Киргизии) или иностранного государства, осуществляющего автоматический обмен финансовой информацией с Российской Федерацией»)
- **Transfer limits for non-residents from unfriendly countries**: From 8 June to 7 December 2026 inclusive the Bank of Russia keeps restrictions: non-residents from unfriendly countries working in Russia may transfer abroad up to their wages; transfers are banned for such non-residents not working in Russia and for legal entities from those countries. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [cbr.ru](https://www.cbr.ru/press/event/?id=32586); Quote: «Банк России сохраняет на период с 8 июня до 7 декабря 2026 года включительно действующие сейчас ограничения: – физические лица – нерезиденты из недружественных стран, работающие в России, могут переводить за рубеж средства в размере заработной платы; – запрет на перевод средств за рубеж для не работающих в России физических лиц – нерезидентов из недружественных стран, а также для юридических лиц из таких государств.»)

### Citizenship: UK

- **Entry**: With a British citizen passport you can visit Türkiye visa-free for up to 90 days in any 180-day period, for business or tourism. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/turkey/entry-requirements); Quote: «If you hold a British citizen passport, you can visit Turkey without a visa for up to 90 days in any 180-day period, for business or tourism»)

### Tax residence: Russia

- **Double tax treaty**: The Russia–Türkiye agreement for the avoidance of double taxation on income is in force: signed 15.12.1997, in force since 31.12.1999, applied from 01.01.2000. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [cdn.gib.gov.tr](https://cdn.gib.gov.tr/api/gibportal-file/file/getFileResources?objectKey=arsiv%2Fmevzuat%2Fuluslararasi_mevzuat%2FCifte_Vergilendirme%2FTurkiyenin_Sonuclandirdigi_Vergi_Anlasmalari_Listesi.pdf); Quote: «41) Rusya 15.12.1997 17.12.1999 - 23909 31.12.1999 01.01.2000»)
- **Credit for Turkish tax**: Under Article 22 of the treaty, tax paid in the other state (Türkiye) on income that may be taxed there under the treaty may be credited against the tax of the state of residence (Russia); the credit may not exceed the tax computed on that income under the residence state's law. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [cdn.gib.gov.tr](https://cdn.gib.gov.tr/api/gibportal-file/file/getFileResources?objectKey=arsiv%2Fmevzuat%2Fuluslararasi_mevzuat%2FTURKCE_METIN%2FRUSYA.pdf); Quote: «MADDE 22 ÇİFTE VERGİLENDİRMENİN ÖNLENMESİ Bir Akit Devlet mukimi, bu Anlaşma hükümlerine uygun olarak diğer Akit Devlette vergilendirilebilen bir gelir elde ettiğinde, bu diğer Devlette ödenen gelire ilişkin vergi tutarı, ilk bahsedilen Devlette alınacak vergiden mahsup edilebilir. Bununla beraber sözkonusu mahsup tutarı, bu gelir için ilk bahsedilen Devletin vergi kanunları ile düzenlemelerine uygun olarak hesaplanan vergi tutarını aşmayacaktır.»)
- **Home-country tax on rental income**: For individuals living in Russia more than 183 days a year, rental income is taxed from 01.01.2025 at the progressive scale of Art. 224(1) Tax Code: 13/15/18/20/22%. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [nalog.gov.ru](https://www.nalog.gov.ru/rn77/fl/pay_taxes/income/realty_sell/); Quote: «Для граждан, проживающих в Российской Федерации более 183 дней в году, такие доходы с 01.01.2025 года облагаются налогом по следующим ставкам: от сдачи имущества в аренду – по прогрессивной шкале налогообложения, установленной п. 1 ст. 224 НК РФ (13%/ 15%/ 18%/ 20%/ 22%);»)
- **Home-country tax on sale**: For individuals living in Russia more than 183 days a year, income from selling property is taxed from 01.01.2025 at the scale of Art. 224(1.1) Tax Code: 13% / 15%. The 15% threshold and the minimum holding period are separate fields below. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [nalog.gov.ru](https://www.nalog.gov.ru/rn77/fl/pay_taxes/income/realty_sell/); Quote: «Для граждан, проживающих в Российской Федерации более 183 дней в году, такие доходы с 01.01.2025 года облагаются налогом по следующим ставкам: от сдачи имущества в аренду – по прогрессивной шкале налогообложения, установленной п. 1 ст. 224 НК РФ (13%/ 15%/ 18%/ 20%/ 22%); от продажи - по шкале налогообложения, установленной п. 1.1 ст. 224 НК РФ (13%/ 15%).»)
- **Treaty art. 6: income from immovable property**: Article 6(1) of the treaty: income of a resident of one state from immovable property situated in the other state may be taxed in that other state. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [cdn.gib.gov.tr](https://cdn.gib.gov.tr/api/gibportal-file/file/getFileResources?objectKey=arsiv%2Fmevzuat%2Fuluslararasi_mevzuat%2FTURKCE_METIN%2FRUSYA.pdf); Quote: «MADDE 6 1. Bir Akit Devlet mukiminin diğer Akit Devlette bulunan gayrimenkul varlıklardan elde ettiği gelir (tarım veya ormancılıktan elde edilen gelir dahil), bu diğer Devlette vergilendirilebilir.»)
- **Treaty art. 13: capital gains**: Article 13(1) of the treaty: gains from the alienation of immovable property situated in the other state may be taxed in that other state. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [cdn.gib.gov.tr](https://cdn.gib.gov.tr/api/gibportal-file/file/getFileResources?objectKey=arsiv%2Fmevzuat%2Fuluslararasi_mevzuat%2FTURKCE_METIN%2FRUSYA.pdf); Quote: «MADDE 13 SERMAYE DEĞER ARTIŞ KAZANÇLARI 1. Bir Akit Devlet mukimince, diğer Akit Devlette yer alan ve 6 nci maddede belirtilen gayrimenkul varlıkların elden çıkarılmasından sağlanan kazançlar, bu diğer Devlette vergilendirilebilir.»)
- **Foreign tax credit procedure (Russia)**: To credit foreign tax (Art. 232 Tax Code), the return must be accompanied by documents on the income and the foreign tax paid, issued or certified by the foreign competent authority, with a notarised Russian translation. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [nalog.gov.ru](https://www.nalog.gov.ru/html/sites/www.new.nalog.ru/docs/minfin/minfin106247_031220.pdf); Quote: «Так, в соответствии с пунктом 3 статьи 232 Кодекса в целях зачета в Российской Федерации суммы налога, уплаченного физическим лицом - налоговым резидентом Российской Федерации в иностранном государстве с полученных им доходов, к налоговой декларации прилагаются документы, подтверждающие сумму полученного в иностранном государстве дохода и уплаченного с этого дохода налога в иностранном государстве, выданные (заверенные) уполномоченным органом соответствующего иностранного государства, и их нотариально заверенный перевод на русский язык.»)
- **Declaring foreign income**: Income from sources outside Russia is reported in the personal income tax return (Appendix 2); the deadline is 30 April of the following year. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [nalog.gov.ru](https://www.nalog.gov.ru/rn21/taxation/taxes/ndfl/14642672/); Quote: «Налоговую декларацию по налогу на доходы физических лиц необходимо представить не позднее 30 апреля года следующего за отчетным (абзац 2 пункта 1 статьи 229 Налогового кодекса Российской Федерации), «иностранные» доходы в которой отражаются в «Приложении 2. Доходы от источников за пределами Российской Федерации».»)
- **Russian tax on sale: rates**: From 2025, personal income tax on selling property has a two-step scale: 13% for income up to RUB 2.4m, 15% for income above RUB 2.4m. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [nalog.gov.ru](https://www.nalog.gov.ru/rn26/news/activities_fts/15849565/); Quote: «С 2025 года введена двухступенчатая шкала по ставкам для НДФЛ при продаже имущества: 13% - для дохода до 2,4 млн руб.; 15% - для дохода более 2,4 млн руб.»)
- **Minimum holding period (Russia)**: If property is sold after being owned for less than the minimum holding period (three or five years), the income must be self-reported on form 3-NDFL. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [nalog.gov.ru](https://www.nalog.gov.ru/rn77/fl/pay_taxes/income/realty_sell/); Quote: «Если Вы сдавали недвижимое имущество физическим лицам, не являющимся индивидуальными предпринимателями, либо продали недвижимое имущество, находившееся у Вас в собственности менее минимального предельного срока владения объектом недвижимого имущества (три года или пять лет) Вам необходимо самостоятельно отразить полученные доходы в налоговой декларации по налогу на доходы физических лиц ( форма 3-НДФЛ).»)

### Tax residence: UK

- **Double tax treaty**: The UK–Türkiye double taxation agreement was signed on 19 February 1986 and entered into force on 26 October 1988 (published on gov.uk as 'in force'). (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/turkey-tax-treaties/1988-uk-turkey-double-taxation-agreement-in-force); Quote: «UK-Turkey double taxation agreement signed 19 February 1986 entered into force 26 October 1988.»)
- **Credit for Turkish tax**: Under Article 23(1)(a) of the treaty, Turkish tax payable under Turkish law and in accordance with the agreement on profits, income or chargeable gains from sources within Turkey is allowed as a credit against UK tax computed by reference to the same profits, income or gains. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/turkey-tax-treaties/1988-uk-turkey-double-taxation-agreement-in-force); Quote: «(a) Turkish tax payable under the law of Turkey and in accordance with this Agreement, whether directly or by deduction, on profits, income or chargeable gains from sources within Turkey (excluding in the case of a dividend, tax payable in respect of the profits out of which the dividend is paid) shall be allowed as a credit against any United Kingdom tax computed by reference to the same profits, income or chargeable gains by reference to which the Turkish tax is computed.»)
- **Home-country tax on rental income**: Tax on overseas property is paid in the normal way; if you rent out more than one, losses can be offset against other overseas properties. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/tax-foreign-income/foreign-income-thats-taxed-differently); Quote: «You pay tax in the normal way on overseas property. But if you rent out more than one, you can offset losses against other overseas properties.»)
- **Home-country tax on sale**: A UK resident pays Capital Gains Tax when disposing of overseas property. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/tax-sell-property/selling-overseas-property); Quote: «You pay Capital Gains Tax when you ‘dispose of’ overseas property if you’re resident in the UK.»)
- **Inheritance tax**: From 6 April 2025, the non-UK (overseas) assets of a long-term UK resident may be subject to Inheritance Tax on a transfer of assets or death. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/inheritance-tax-if-youre-a-long-term-uk-resident); Quote: «From 6 April 2025, if you are a long-term UK resident, your non-UK (overseas) assets may be subject to Inheritance Tax if you make a transfer of assets or die.»)
- **Foreign Tax Credit Relief (UK)**: Foreign Tax Credit Relief can usually be claimed when reporting overseas income in the tax return; how much relief you get depends on the UK's double-taxation agreement with the source country. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/tax-foreign-income/taxed-twice); Quote: «You can usually claim Foreign Tax Credit Relief when you report your overseas income in your tax return. How much relief you get depends on the UK’s ‘double-taxation agreement’ with the country your income’s from.»)
- **Treaty art. 6: income from immovable property**: Article 6(1) of the treaty: income of a resident of one state from immovable property situated in the other state may be taxed in that other state. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/turkey-tax-treaties/1988-uk-turkey-double-taxation-agreement-in-force); Quote: «Article 6: income from immovable property (1) Income derived by a resident of a Contracting State from immovable property (including income from agriculture or forestry) situated in the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State.»)
- **Treaty art. 13: capital gains**: Article 13(1) of the treaty: gains from the alienation of immovable property situated in the other state may be taxed in that other state. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/turkey-tax-treaties/1988-uk-turkey-double-taxation-agreement-in-force); Quote: «Article 13: capital gains (1) Gains derived by a resident of a Contracting State from the alienation of immovable property referred to in Article 6 of this Agreement and situated in the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State.»)
- **Capital Gains Tax rates**: CGT from 6 April 2026: 18% within the basic Income Tax band, 24% above it. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/capital-gains-tax/rates); Quote: «If this amount is within the basic Income Tax band, you’ll pay 18% on your gains made from 6 April 2026. For any amount above the basic Income Tax band, you’ll pay 24% on gains made from 6 April 2026.»)
- **Inheritance tax: long-term resident test**: You are a long-term UK resident in a tax year if you were UK tax resident for either the previous 10 consecutive years or a total of 10 years or more within the previous 20 years. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/inheritance-tax-if-youre-a-long-term-uk-resident); Quote: «You are a long-term UK resident in a tax year if you are tax resident in the UK for either: the previous 10 years consecutive years a total of 10 years or more within the previous 20 years»)
- **Inheritance tax after leaving the UK**: Long-term UK residence can be kept for up to 10 tax years after leaving the UK; this is shorter if you have not lived in the UK for all the previous 20 years. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/inheritance-tax-if-youre-a-long-term-uk-resident); Quote: «You can still keep long-term UK residence for up to 10 tax years after you leave the UK. This is shorter if you have not lived in the UK for all the previous 20 years.»)

#### FCA, FSCS and Financial Ombudsman Service (UK)

- **FCA warning**: FCA: a collective investment scheme not authorised by the FCA is an unregulated collective investment scheme (UCIS); it does not have to meet the same standards, and if something goes wrong your money may not be protected. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [fca.org.uk](https://www.fca.org.uk/investsmart/unregulated-collective-investment-schemes); Quote: «If a CIS has not been authorised by us, it is considered an unregulated collective investment scheme (UCIS). This means it does not have to meet the same standards, and if something goes wrong, your money may not be protected.»)
- **FCA: UCIS and hotel rooms**: FCA: UCIS may invest in riskier assets that are tricky to value at any given time — these include hotel rooms, plots of land and whisky. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [fca.org.uk](https://www.fca.org.uk/investsmart/unregulated-collective-investment-schemes); Quote: «UCIS may invest in riskier assets or use riskier investment strategies than authorised schemes. Riskier assets could include things that are tricky to value at any given time - these include hotel rooms, plots of land and whisky.»)
- **FCA PERG 11.2: scheme structure**: FCA (PERG guidance on property investment clubs): whether a property investment club is a collective investment scheme depends on its individual structure and the facts surrounding it. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [handbook.fca.org.uk](https://www.handbook.fca.org.uk/handbook/PERG/11/2.html); Quote: «Whether your property investment club is a collective investment scheme or not will depend on its individual structure and the facts surrounding it.»)
- **FOS and FSCS protection**: If a firm offering an investment is not FCA-regulated, there are generally far fewer protections: for example, you are unlikely to be able to complain to the Financial Ombudsman Service or claim from the FSCS. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [fca.org.uk](https://www.fca.org.uk/news/statements/beware-high-risk-investments-unregulated-firms); Quote: «If a firm offering an investment is not regulated by the FCA there are generally far fewer protections. For example, you are unlikely to be able to take complaints to the Financial Ombudsman Service and you’re unlikely to be able to make a claim through the Financial Services Compensation Scheme.»)

****Turkey: taxes, buying, residence permit****

- **Right of Russian citizens to buy**: General principle (Russia is not named in the source): the countries whose nationals are eligible to acquire real estate in Türkiye are determined by the Cabinet of Ministers, which may also set special conditions. Whether Russia is on the list — see the field “Is Russia on the country list” below. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [invest.gov.tr](https://www.invest.gov.tr/en/investmentguide/pages/acquiring-property-and-citizenship.aspx); Quote: «Countries whose nationals are eligible to acquire real estate in Türkiye are determined by the Cabinet of Ministers, who may also stipulate special conditions for acquisitions if deemed necessary.»)
- **Right of UK citizens to buy**: FCDO guidance for British nationals states the general conditions for foreigners: up to 30 hectares in Turkey in total per person plus limited rights in rem; no acquisition or rental within military forbidden zones and security zones. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/how-to-buy-property-in-turkey); Quote: «a) Persons with foreign nationality can buy maximum 30 hectares of property in Turkey in total and can acquire limited in rem right. b) Foreigners cannot acquire or rent property within military forbidden zones and security zones.»)
- **Title deed fee (tapu harcı)**: Title deed fee (tapu harcı) on transfer: 20 per mille (2%) of the declared actual transfer price, charged separately to buyer and seller. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [cdn.gib.gov.tr](https://cdn.gib.gov.tr/api/gibportal-file/file/getFileResources?objectKey=arsiv%2Fonceki-dokumanlar%2Fgayrimenkul_alimsatim_vergilendirilmesi.pdf); Quote: «Gayrimenkul devir ve iktisaplarında tapu harcı, beyan edilen gerçek devir ve iktisap bedeli üzerinden binde 20 oranında alıcı ve satıcıdan ayrı ayrı alınır.»)
- **Annual property tax**: Property tax (emlak vergisi) rates: residential buildings 1 per mille (0.1%), other buildings 2 per mille, land 1, building plots 3 per mille. Within metropolitan municipality boundaries and adjacent areas the rates are increased by 100%. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [cdn.gib.gov.tr](https://cdn.gib.gov.tr/api/gibportal-file/file/getFileResources?objectKey=arsiv/onceki-dokumanlar/emlak_ver_rehber_2025.pdf); Quote: «Bina vergisinin oranı meskenlerde binde 1, • Diğer binalarda binde 2, • Arazide binde 1 ve arsalarda binde 3’tür. Bina, arsa ve arazilere ilişkin vergi oranları büyükşehir belediye sınırları ve mücavir alanlar içinde %100 artırımlı uygulanır.»)
- **Rental income tax (non-resident)**: Rental income is taxed at a progressive scale (GİB guide for non-residents): 15%, 20%, 27%, 35%, 40% with TL brackets. The regime for short-term rentals and rental pools is not covered by this quote (see the short-term rental field below). (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [cdn.gib.gov.tr](https://cdn.gib.gov.tr/api/gibportal-file/file/getFileResources?objectKey=arsiv%2Ffileadmin%2Fbeyannamerehberi%2F2026%2F2026_theguidebooktaxpayers.pdf); Quote: «Income subject to income tax is taxed at the following rates. Up to the amount of 158.000 TL 15% 23.700 TL for 158.000 TL of 330.000 TL, over 20% 58.100 TL for 330.000 TL of 800.000 TL (for wage incomes 58.100 TL for 330.000 TL of 1.200.000 TL), over 27% 185.000 TL for 800.000 TL of 4.300.000 TL, (for wage incomes 293.000 TL for 1.200.000 TL of 4.300.000 TL), over 35% 1.410.000 TL for 4.300.000 TL of amount exceeding 4.300.000 TL (for wage incomes 1.378.000 TL for 4.300.000 TL of amount exceeding 4.300.000 TL), over 40%»)
- **Residence permit via property: minimum value**: For applicants owning immovable property in Türkiye: a document showing the residence belongs to the applicant (title deed copy); the house must be worth at least USD 200 thousand (TRY equivalent) as of the date of acquisition. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [e-ikamet.goc.gov.tr](https://e-ikamet.goc.gov.tr/Ikamet/BasvuruIstenenBelgeler/BasvuruFormuIstenenBelgeler?tur=0); Quote: «b. Those owning immovable property in Türkiye  Official, e-signed/signed and sealed/stamped document showing that the residence belongs to the applicant foreigner (Photocopy of the title deed) (The value of the house must be at least 200 thousand US Dollars equivalent to Turkish Lira as of the date of acquisition).»)
- **Residence permit: property use requirement**: The property must be a residence and be used by the foreigner for this purpose; it cannot be used for rent or similar income-generating purposes. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [e-ikamet.goc.gov.tr](https://e-ikamet.goc.gov.tr/Ikamet/BasvuruIstenenBelgeler/BasvuruFormuIstenenBelgeler?tur=0); Quote: «(The immovable property must be a residence and must be used by the foreigner for this purpose. The residence cannot be used for rent and similar income generating purposes.)»)
- **Citizenship-by-investment threshold**: Citizenship criterion: acquiring property worth at least USD 400,000 or equivalent foreign currency with a title-deed restriction on resale for at least three years, as attested by the Ministry of Environment, Urbanization and Climate Change. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [invest.gov.tr](https://www.invest.gov.tr/en/investmentguide/pages/acquiring-property-and-citizenship.aspx); Quote: «Acquiring a property worth a minimum of USD 400,000 or equivalent foreign currency with a title deed restriction on its resale for at least three years, as attested by the Ministry of Environment, Urbanization and Climate Change»)
- **Purchase procedure**: Documents for the land registry procedure (invest.gov.tr, «Requirements for Land Registry Procedures»): ID or passport, representation document (if any), municipal market-value document, mandatory earthquake insurance for buildings. Other steps are listed as separate fields below. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [invest.gov.tr](https://www.invest.gov.tr/en/investmentguide/pages/acquiring-property-and-citizenship.aspx); Quote: «Photo ID or passport issued by the country of which the foreigner is a citizen (notarized and certified translations should be submitted for ID cards and passports issued in alphabets other than the Latin alphabet) If the procedure involves representation, document regarding representation (order regarding guardianship, letter of authorization, power of attorney etc.) Document on the current market value of the real estate issued by the relevant municipality Mandatory earthquake insurance policy for the buildings»)
- **Is Russia on the list of eligible countries**: no data (Checked: 2026-10-19; [invest.gov.tr](https://www.invest.gov.tr/en/investmentguide/pages/acquiring-property-and-citizenship.aspx))
- **Restrictions on foreign buyers**: General limits for foreigners: at most 30 hectares in Turkey in total per person; no acquisition or rental within military forbidden zones and security zones; persons with foreign nationality can acquire property or limited rights in rem in a district/town up to 10% of the total area of that district/town. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/how-to-buy-property-in-turkey); Quote: «a) Persons with foreign nationality can buy maximum 30 hectares of property in Turkey in total and can acquire limited in rem right. b) Foreigners cannot acquire or rent property within military forbidden zones and security zones. c) Persons with foreign nationality can acquire property or limited in rem right in a district/town up to 10 % of the total area of the said district/town.»)
- **Withholding tax on rent**: Tenants that are persons, corporations or entities referred to in the guide must withhold income tax at 20% of the gross rental payments. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [cdn.gib.gov.tr](https://cdn.gib.gov.tr/api/gibportal-file/file/getFileResources?objectKey=arsiv%2Ffileadmin%2Fbeyannamerehberi%2F2026%2F2026_theguidebooktaxpayers.pdf); Quote: «Persons, corporations and entities in question that are tenants have to withhold income tax from the gross amount of their rental payments at the rate of 20%.»)
- **Residential rental income exemption**: Residential rental income is exempt from income tax up to TRY 47,000 for 2025 (TRY 58,000 for 2026); stated in the GİB guide for non-resident taxpayers. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [cdn.gib.gov.tr](https://cdn.gib.gov.tr/api/gibportal-file/file/getFileResources?objectKey=arsiv%2Ffileadmin%2Fbeyannamerehberi%2F2026%2F2026_theguidebooktaxpayers.pdf); Quote: «The amount of 47.000 TL for rental income from house for the year 2025 (the exception amount of 58.000 TL for the year 2026) is exempted from the income tax.»)
- **Short-term letting: taxation**: Turkish Revenue Administration (GİB, a private ruling — özelge — issued to a taxpayer): continuously letting real estate for short periods (daily, weekly or monthly) within a commercial organisation is treated as a commercial activity, and the income is taxed under the Income Tax Law rules on commercial income (ticari kazanç). (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [gib.gov.tr](https://gib.gov.tr/mevzuat/kanun/433/ozelge/38812); Quote: «Buna göre, gayrimenkulleri ticari bir organizasyon çerçevesinde devamlı olarak günlük, haftalık veya aylık periyotlar halinde kısa süreli olarak kiraya verme faaliyetinizin ticari faaliyet kapsamında değerlendirilmesi ve bu faaliyet dolayısıyla elde ettiğiniz kazancın da Gelir Vergisi Kanununun ticari kazanca ilişkin hükümlerine göre vergilendirilmesi gerekmektedir.»)
- **Short-term letting: bookkeeping (FCDO guidance)**: Per FCDO guidance (gov.uk): income from short-period rentals is subject to commercial income tax; a tax account, an accountant and financial books are required. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/how-to-buy-property-in-turkey); Quote: «On the other hand, if you rent for short periods then this income will be subject to commercial income tax. You must have a tax account, an accountant, and keep financial books.»)
- **Purchase step: encumbrance check**: Mortgages, liens and similar restrictions that could prevent the sale are checked before procedures start at the land registry directorate. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [invest.gov.tr](https://www.invest.gov.tr/en/investmentguide/pages/acquiring-property-and-citizenship.aspx); Quote: «Burdens such as mortgages, liens, and similar types of restrictions that may exist with regard to the said property that would prevent the sale thereof should be checked prior to the initiation of procedures at the respective land registry directorate.»)
- **Purchase step: foreigner ID number**: A buyer without a residence permit needs a Foreigner Identity number (Yabancı Kimlik No.) from the TNP Foreigners’ Department in the nearest city; the service is free (per FCDO guidance). (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/how-to-buy-property-in-turkey); Quote: «However, anyone wishing to buy property in Turkey who does not hold a residence permit needs to obtain their Foreigner Identity number (Yabanci Kimlik No.) from the TNP Foreigners’ Department in the nearest city (not local town) in order to proceed with the property purchase. This service is free of charge.»)
- **Purchase step: valuation report**: The evaluation report is valid for three months and is submitted to the title deed office (per FCDO guidance). (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/how-to-buy-property-in-turkey); Quote: «The evaluation report, which is valid only for three months, should be submitted to the title deed office.»)
- **Purchase step: tapu application**: The buyer applies to the land registry together with the owner; appointments via the Alo 181 call centre or randevu.tkgm.gov.tr. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [invest.gov.tr](https://www.invest.gov.tr/en/investmentguide/pages/acquiring-property-and-citizenship.aspx); Quote: «A natural or legal person intending to acquire real estate in Türkiye is required to apply to the General Directorate of Land Registry and Cadastre together with the owner of the property. In addition, they may call the Alo 181 Call Center, offering service around the clock, or visit randevu.tkgm.gov.tr to make an appointment without having to visit the directorates’ offices in person.»)
- **Purchase step: title registration**: Preliminary real estate contracts (notarised or written between individuals) do not transfer ownership per se; they are only a commitment to transfer. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [invest.gov.tr](https://www.invest.gov.tr/en/investmentguide/pages/acquiring-property-and-citizenship.aspx); Quote: «Preliminary real estate contracts, issued by notaries or entered into by natural persons in writing, do not confer transfer of property per se. They only serve as a commitment for the transfer of ownership; the property in question does not change hands by means of such instruments.»)
- **Sales to foreigners statistics**: no data (Checked: 2026-10-19; [veriportali.tuik.gov.tr](https://veriportali.tuik.gov.tr/tr/press/58350/metadata))

## What we don't know

What our sources do not confirm — and ready questions you can ask the seller yourself.

**Not found** (15): Coordinates, Brand, Operator, Developer / seller, Project status, Stars, Ministry of Culture and Tourism licence (KTB), Number of rooms, Year-round or seasonal, Rental programme type, Owner's share of income, Owner nights per year, Rental contract term, Title type, Red flags

**Seller's claim** (4): Address, Project type, Rental programme, Guaranteed income

### Questions for the seller

#### Project

1. Please give the exact address of the project (il / ilçe / mahalle, street) and the land registry plot (ada / parsel).
2. Please send the coordinates or a map link with the exact location of the building.
3. Is this a hotel, apart-hotel or serviced residence according to its documents?
4. Under which hotel brand does (will) the property operate? Is a franchise or management agreement signed — please send a copy or an extract.
5. Who is the hotel operator (legal entity) and who is the counterparty of the owner's rental agreement? What happens if the operator changes?
6. Who is the developer (legal entity) and who is the seller under the sale contract?
7. Is the property operating or under construction? If under construction — the contractual completion date and building permit (yapı ruhsatı); if operating — the opening year and occupancy permit (iskân).
8. What official star rating has the hotel been assigned (per the Ministry of Culture and Tourism certificate)?
9. Does the hotel hold a Ministry of Culture and Tourism licence (Turizm İşletme Belgesi)? Please send its number and a copy.
10. How many rooms are in the hotel part in total and how many of them are sold to private owners?
11. Does the hotel operate year-round or seasonally? In which months is it closed?

#### Rental

1. Is there a rental programme run by the operator? Please send a sample agreement.
2. Is the rental programme a shared pool (income split among all owners) or individual (income from your own unit)?
3. What share of rental income does the owner receive and which costs are deducted before it is calculated?
4. Is there a guaranteed income? Who exactly guarantees it (legal entity), for how long, on what base amount, and how is the guarantee secured?
5. How many nights a year may the owner stay in the unit and are there restrictions by month?
6. For what term is the rental/management agreement signed, how can it be terminated and what happens if the operator changes?

#### Title and documents

1. Is a separate title deed (kat mülkiyeti / kat irtifakı) issued for the unit? Please send a copy showing the plot number.
2. Please give the full legal name (unvan), tax number (vergi no) or MERSIS of the developer and the hotel-owning company; have they had konkordato, liquidation, a change of owners or icra sales involving the property?

## Tax and law

### Citizenship: Russia

- **Entry**: Russian citizens with ordinary passports are visa-exempt for tourist and business trips to Türkiye of up to 60 days. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [mfa.gov.tr](https://www.mfa.gov.tr/visa-information-for-foreigners.en.mfa); Quote: «Russian Federation: Ordinary passport holders are exempted from visa for their touristic and business travels up to 60 days.»)
- **Currency control**: A resident individual files the report with the tax office annually, by 1 June of the year following the reporting year. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [nalog.gov.ru](https://www.nalog.gov.ru/rn77/related_activities/exchange_controls/); Quote: «Физическое лицо - резидент представляет в налоговый орган по месту своего учета отчет ежегодно, до 1 июня года, следующего за отчетным годом.»)
- **Notice to Russian tax service of a foreign account**: A resident must notify the tax office of opening, closing or changing details of an account with a foreign (e.g. Turkish) bank within one month. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [nalog.gov.ru](https://www.nalog.gov.ru/rn77/fl/interest/account_opening/); Quote: «Резидент уведомляет налоговый орган по месту своего учета об открытии (закрытии) счетов (вкладов) и об изменении реквизитов счетов (вкладов) в банках и иных организациях финансового рынка, расположенных за пределами территории Российской Федерации, не позднее одного месяца со дня соответственно открытия (закрытия) или изменения реквизитов таких счетов (вкладов) по форме, утвержденной федеральным органом исполнительной власти, уполномоченным по контролю и надзору в области налогов и сборов.»)
- **Transfer limits**: From 8 December 2025 the Bank of Russia lifted the previously set limits on foreign-currency transfers abroad for Russian citizens and non-resident individuals from friendly countries. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [cbr.ru](https://www.cbr.ru/press/event?id=28158); Quote: «Учитывая стабильную ситуацию на валютном рынке, с 8 декабря 2025 года Банк России отменяет ранее установленные лимиты на переводы иностранной валюты за рубеж для граждан России и физических лиц – нерезидентов из дружественных стран.»)
- **Banks and transfer methods**: no data (Checked: 2026-10-19; Where we searched: cbr.ru nalog.gov.ru mfa.gov.tr tcmb.gov.tr)
- **Currency control: exemption for stays abroad over 183 days (accounts)**: The requirements on opening accounts (deposits) with foreign banks and other financial-market organisations do not apply to residents who stay outside Russia for more than 183 days in total during a calendar year. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [nalog.gov.ru](https://www.nalog.gov.ru/rn77/related_activities/exchange_controls/); Quote: «Требования к порядку открытия счетов (вкладов) в банках и иных организациях финансового рынка, расположенных за пределами территории Российской Федерации, не применяются к физическим лицам - резидентам, срок пребывания которых за пределами территории Российской Федерации в течение календарного года в совокупности составит более 183 дней»)
- **Currency control: exemption for stays abroad over 183 days (reports)**: The requirements to file cash-flow reports on accounts with foreign banks and other financial-market organisations (and reports on transfers via foreign payment providers without an account) do not apply to residents who stay outside Russia for more than 183 days in total during a calendar year. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [nalog.gov.ru](https://www.nalog.gov.ru/rn77/related_activities/exchange_controls/); Quote: «Требования к порядку представления отчетов о движении денежных средств и иных финансовых активов по счетам (вкладам) в банках и иных организациях финансового рынка, расположенных за пределами территории Российской Федерации и отчетов о переводах денежных средств без открытия банковского счета с использованием электронных средств платежа, предоставленных иностранными поставщиками платежных услуг не применяются к физическим лицам - резидентам, срок пребывания которых за пределами территории Российской Федерации в течение календарного года в совокупности составит более 183 дней»)
- **Currency control: credits to a foreign account**: Since 1 January 2020 residents may credit funds from non-residents to their foreign accounts without restriction, provided the account is in an EAEU state or a state that exchanges financial information automatically with Russia. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [nalog.gov.ru](https://www.nalog.gov.ru/rn77/related_activities/exchange_controls/); Quote: «С 1 января 2020 года физические лица – резиденты могут без ограничений зачислять средства от нерезидентов на свои зарубежные счета при условии: счет должен быть открыт в зарубежном банке на территории государства-члена ЕАЭС (Беларуси, Казахстана, Армении, Киргизии) или иностранного государства, осуществляющего автоматический обмен финансовой информацией с Российской Федерацией»)
- **Transfer limits for non-residents from unfriendly countries**: From 8 June to 7 December 2026 inclusive the Bank of Russia keeps restrictions: non-residents from unfriendly countries working in Russia may transfer abroad up to their wages; transfers are banned for such non-residents not working in Russia and for legal entities from those countries. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [cbr.ru](https://www.cbr.ru/press/event/?id=32586); Quote: «Банк России сохраняет на период с 8 июня до 7 декабря 2026 года включительно действующие сейчас ограничения: – физические лица – нерезиденты из недружественных стран, работающие в России, могут переводить за рубеж средства в размере заработной платы; – запрет на перевод средств за рубеж для не работающих в России физических лиц – нерезидентов из недружественных стран, а также для юридических лиц из таких государств.»)

### Citizenship: UK

- **Entry**: With a British citizen passport you can visit Türkiye visa-free for up to 90 days in any 180-day period, for business or tourism. (Source type: official; Checked: 2026-10-19; [gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/turkey/entry-requirements); Quote: «If you hold a British citizen passport, you can visit Turkey without a visa for up to 90 days in any 180-day period, for business or tourism»)
